notes.title: Team UP - GAME UPDATE
notes.content:
Hey Everyone!
we are glad to announce that we released a new update, and we hope you can give us your support and feedback on the game.
The Game Update includes Server enhancement, Frame rate enhancement, more decorations, and probs for gameplay, offline mode, a striking new weapon effects and characters, and a number of major gameplay fixes and improvements. More on that below:

• HUD Updated
• Fixing some of the environment glitches.
• New User-Interface for the game.
• Fixed chat system.
• Enhancing the impact effect.
• Smoother menu transitions.
• Enhancing Character health logic.
• Enhancing weapon effect logic and weapon polish effect [beta].
• Making use of both hands [user can use both hands in-game, right hand for shooting and left hand for opening settings panel].
• Adding navigation window [Setting menu applied which covers Audio, Player Speed and help menus].
• Adding After bullet effect. 

Be sure to join us on Discord! and it’s a great way to chat with the Team Up community and Team Up Development Team. Of course, you can always stay up to date with the latest news on our Reddit, Facebook, and Twitter.
Discord Channel: https://discord.gg/2uPz2WU
Reddit: https://www.reddit.com/r/TeamUp_VR/
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/TeamUpArenaVR/
Twitter: https://twitter.com/ArenaTeamup
